_about: NPC lines (0.99.2). Shown as speech bubbles; tools/voice/text.py writes src/voicelines.js from this file. Spoken audio is off for now: tools/voice/make.py can still voice them (Kokoro: each character's voice, speed and pitch below), and tools/voice/sample_chatterbox.py tries Chatterbox.

greet: Oh, there you are. Come in, come in, before the cold follows you.
I put the kettle on when I saw you on the road. Don't make me drink both cups.
Sit down a minute, love. You've got that look again. Have you slept at all?
near: Back in one piece. Good. I do worry, you know.
Shut the door, love, you're letting all the warm out.
It's not much, Haven. But it's ours, isn't it?
questDone: You did it? Oh, good. I knew you would. Still worried myself silly, mind.
Well, that's that. Now go and rest before something else turns up.

greet: Forge is hot. What've you broken this time?
Put it on the anvil. Let's have a look.
Iron, I'll take. Stories, I'll listen to while I work.
near: Watch the sparks.
That blade's gone dull. Bring it by later.
Up the ridge again? Keep your head down up there, eh?
questDone: Good. Good work. ...Don't make me say it twice.
Done already? Huh. Edric would've liked you.

greet: Get out of that wind. Now, where does it hurt? And don't say nowhere.
I've got something for most things. Not everything, mind. I won't lie to you.
Sit. You look like you're carrying a lot more than that pack.
near: The thyme's come up nicely this year. That's something, at least.
Have something warm before you head out. Doctor's orders. Well. Old doctor's orders.
Careful on the fen road. People still pick up fevers out there.
questDone: Thank you. Really. Hardly anyone comes back to tell me how it turned out.
There. That's one less thing I have to lie awake over.

greet: You're back! I saw you from the gate! I was watching the whole time!
Did you go on the road? Is it still there? Did you see anybody on it?
I'm not scared of the mountain. I'm just keeping an eye on it. That's different.
near: Someone has to watch the gate. So I do it.
Are you going out again? You have to come back, okay? Promise?
Wren says I'll grow into this scarf. It's taking ages.
questDone: You did it? For real? Really for real? I'm telling everyone!
Thank you. I'll keep it super safe. I promise.

greet: Pip... Pip. Home before dark.
The door. I know this door.
Pip?
near: Home before dark. Have to be home before dark.
Pip? Is that...
Nearly home. Nearly.

greet: I'm home. Nineteen years... I'd forgotten how good that sounds.
Sit with us a while. He's asleep, but he'll know you came.
near: Listen. You can hear him breathing. That's all I need, really.
I never said it properly. Thank you. For bringing me home.

greet: Hi! Welcome! Sister Odile's notes say be polite, so... hello. Very politely.
What can I get you? I know where everything is now. Mostly.
Just don't touch the thyme. She underlined that. Twice.
near: Nice day for picking herbs. Or getting chased by things. Up to you, really.
Sister Odile would tell you to drink some water. So, um. Drink some water.
I talk to the herbs sometimes. They haven't said anything back. Yet.
questDone: You did it! She'd be so proud. She wouldn't say it, but she would be.

greet: Sit by the fire, dear. I'll tell it again. It comes out a bit different every time, but that's stories for you.
Oh, look who it is. The one the story's about. Don't let it go to your head.
Come, sit, sit. The fire's warm, and I've got all night.
near: Every night you hold, I get to change the ending. I do like that.
Once upon a time there was a keep... and, well, here you are, standing in it.
Old? Me? I'm not old, dear. I've just got a lot of stories.
night: Here they come. You hold them off, and I'll make a song out of it.
Hear them out there? Go on, then. Give them something to remember.
heroDown: Oh, one's fallen. I'll remember their name. Someone has to.
hearthHit: The Hearth! Keep them off the fire, or there'll be nobody left to tell it!
nightHeld: Morning, at last. Oh, what a story that'll make. Let me get it right.
nightLost: Well. Not every story ends well the first time. We'll try it again tomorrow.
bossDown: Their king's down! Oh, I've waited my whole life to tell that bit.
seraph: She's awake. I've told that story so long, I'd half forgotten it was true.

greet: Watch the lamps. I made every one of those by hand, so... careful.
Need light? I've got plenty. Just remember to trim the wick, all right?
The Unmade took my wish for light. So I made my own. Took me a while.
near: If you see a lamp out on your way, give me a shout.
I'll keep the lamps going tonight. You keep the dark off them.
Hang on, this one's smoking again. Every single time.
night: Lamps are lit! Let them see what's waiting for them!
Here comes the dark. Come on, then!
heroDown: Someone's down! Get a light over there, quick!
hearthHit: They're at the Hearth! Don't let them put it out!
nightHeld: Dawn. Right, I'll see to the wicks. You go and sit down.
nightLost: The lamps went out. That's fine. We'll light them again. We always do.
bossDown: Ha! It hated the light, didn't it? Good riddance!
seraph: Look at her glow. I couldn't make a lamp like that in a hundred years.

greet: Twenty years at a gate and nobody ever came. And now look at the place.
All's well. Walls up, gate shut, kettle on.
Commander. I know, I know, you never asked for the title.
near: I check the gate twice a night. Old habit. Good one, though.
Bit quiet out there. I don't trust quiet.
Stand up straight. Somebody's always watching a gate.
night: On the walls! They're coming out of the trees!
Hold the gate! Steady! Steady now!
heroDown: Hero down! Cover them, cover them!
hearthHit: They're on the Hearth! Fall back to the fire!
nightHeld: Gate held. All night. Never thought I'd be proud of a gate.
nightLost: We fell back. No shame in that. We'll stand again tonight.
bossDown: Their king's down! That's the night won!
seraph: An angel at our gate. I'd have given twenty years for that.

greet: Oh, don't worry about your boots. The soil doesn't mind.
Come and look, things are actually growing! Slowly, but they are.
I planted beans where the Unmade walked last night. They're doing really well, actually.
near: Mind the seedlings, please. They've had a rough week.
The bees came back today. I nearly cried, honestly.
If you see a slug, that's not my fault. They just turn up.
night: Not the garden! Please, not the garden!
They're trampling everything! Push them back!
heroDown: Someone's hurt! Get them out of the mud!
hearthHit: The Hearth! Something's wrong with the fire, help it!
nightHeld: Morning. Dew on everything. And we're still here.
nightLost: Well. Things grow back. That's sort of the point of them.
bossDown: It's down! Oh, the ground's going to make something lovely out of that.
seraph: She's like a seed that waited ages and ages to open.

greet: Is it true you went all the way down? What's at the bottom? Was it scary?
I can carry stuff! Heavy stuff. Well. Medium stuff.
Can you teach me something? Anything! How do you stand like that?
near: When I'm big I'm gonna fight the night too.
I practised your swing with a stick. I hit the fence. By accident.
Everyone talks about you. I talk about you the most.
night: Get them! Get them! I'm hiding, but get them!
They're coming! I'm not scared! Okay, a bit scared!
heroDown: No! Get up! Come on, get up!
hearthHit: The Hearth! They're hitting the Hearth!
nightHeld: We won! Did you see? Did you see us win?
nightLost: That's okay. Heroes lose sometimes. You said that. I think you did.
bossDown: You beat the big one! That was the best thing ever!
seraph: The statue moved! It moved! And it's you!

greet: Relax. I only take what people give me now. Mostly.
You caught me nine times. The tenth, I let you.
Lost something? I probably know where it is. Don't ask how.
near: Keep a hand on your purse. Not because of me. Just habit.
Nice boots. I'm not taking them. I'm just saying they're nice.
Don't look at me like that. I've been good. Mostly good.
night: Watch the Faith. Some of them are thieves. I know the tricks.
Eyes open. They'll go for anything shiny.
heroDown: One's down. Somebody grab them before the dark does.
hearthHit: They're going for the Hearth. Clever. Stop them.
nightHeld: Not bad. I'd steal a morning like this, if I still stole things.
nightLost: They took more than I ever did. We'll get it back.
bossDown: The big one's down. I'd say I'm impressed. ...Fine. I'm impressed.
seraph: Now that's a treasure. And for once, nobody has to steal it.

hurt: I can't hold them much longer!
boss: The Tidecaller! Watch out for its slam!
cheer: We held! Ha! The keep's still standing!

hurt: I'm not gonna last much longer!
